You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: every wrong submission costs 1 and every demo request costs 1. An
instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt cap is reached, and
reaching the cap is charged the full cap. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

# Continual-ARC task-bea89b76: outlined-frame fills by interior parity

For this recurring task, identify hollow rectangular outlines (including square outlines) on the background. Preserve every outline cell and all unrelated cells. Fill only the enclosed interior:

- If both interior dimensions are odd, fill every interior cell with 7.
- If both interior dimensions are even, fill every interior cell with 2.

Observed examples are square frames, so the demonstrated parity classes coincide across height and width: interiors 1×1, 3×3, and 5×5 are filled with 7; interiors 2×2 and 4×4 are filled with 2. The test included several 3×3 hollow frames with varied outline colors; all centers became 7. Background and outline colors vary; do not assume outline color determines fill.

## Evidence

- Demo 1: a 3×3 color-4 frame on background 8 had its 1×1 interior changed to 7. A 6×6 color-9 frame and 4×4 color-0 frame had 4×4 and 2×2 interiors filled with 2.
- Demo 2: 3×3 frames (colors 3, 4, 5) were filled at center with 7; 5×5 frames (colors 9 and 8) and a 7×7 color-8 frame had odd-sided interiors filled with 7. A 6×6 color-8 frame had its 4×4 interior filled with 2.
- Fresh test: five 3×3 frames on background 3, with outline colors 1, 0, 6, and 5, had each center changed to 7; outlines and background otherwise remained unchanged. This was accepted.
- Fresh test: on a 21×29 background-6 grid, an 8-colored 4×4 frame had its 2×2 interior filled with 2, and a 5-colored 5×5 frame had its 3×3 interior filled with 7; all else was preserved. The submission was accepted.

## Application checks

1. Locate complete one-cell-thick rectangular outlines; measure the enclosed interior dimensions, excluding the perimeter.
2. Apply parity-based fill to interiors only, preserving the complete perimeter.
3. Preserve all non-frame cells and verify dimensions and row/column coordinates before submitting.
4. Before serialization, verify the output has exactly the input row count and every row has exactly the input column count; invalid ARC grid formatting incurs a wrong attempt even when the intended transformation is correct. Prefer copying the input and changing only the identified interior cells.

## Additional fresh evidence

- A 13×15 test had three hollow frames: a 3×3 color-0 frame with a 1×1 interior, a 7×7 color-6 frame with a 5×5 interior, and a 3×3 color-8 frame with a 1×1 interior. Each interior was filled with 7, while all other cells were preserved; accepted. The initial attempted output was rejected as an invalid grid due to an output formatting/dimension mistake, then the corrected 13×15 grid was accepted. Always check row widths and count before submitting.
- Fresh 16×9 test: a 7×7 color-1 outline on background 8 and a 7×7 color-3 outline on background 8 each enclosed a 5×5 interior; both were filled with 7, all outlines and background preserved. Accepted with zero wrong attempts. This adds confirmation that multiple spatially separate same-sized frames in a mixed-background grid are independently filled.
